[5][30] Morning on the Saltmere breakwater.
[32][58] The ferry leaves at seven,|as it has for forty years.
[60][80] [gulls calling]
[82][110] Tide's turning. We should check|the mooring buoys.
[112][140] The lighthouse keeper logs|every boat that passes.

[168][195] Harbour office, this is the pilot launch.
[197][220] Fog rolls in from the outer mole by noon.
[222][250] Keep to the marked channel|past the red buoy.
[252][280] By evening the quay is quiet again.
